description: This file defines a SwiftUI View named ChatSheet, which provides a chat UI component for an iOS app using the OpenClaw framework. It manages a chat session, including dismissing the view and displaying the chat interface with a dynamic title.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the ChatSheet view with a gateway session, session key, agent name, and user accent color, setting up the view model and properties.

methods.name: body
methods.description: Defines the SwiftUI view for the chat interface, including navigation and toolbar actions.

methods.name: chatTitle
methods.description: Computes the navigation title based on the agent's name, defaulting to 'Chat' if none is provided.

calls: OpenClawChatView(viewModel: self.viewModel, showsSessionSwitcher: true, userAccent: self.userAccent)
